## What was ported

| Concern | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Routing | All 6 resources × {list, `/filter`, GET/PUT/DELETE `/{id}`} + `/users/{id}/userGroups`, `/groups/{id}/users`, with Spring-style trailing-slash matching and HEAD |
| Security | HTTP Basic against `users` (bcrypt, inactive blocked), roles = user roles ∪ group roles, `ROLE_ADMIN > ROLE_USER` hierarchy; 401 (with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="SHOGun Realm"`), 403 for authenticated-but-unauthorized |
| Permissions | Faithful port of all evaluators: self-read, group-member read, always-read types (roles/datasources/appearances), user+group permission collections, `ADMIN` permission, super-admin bypass; PostFilter on lists, PostAuthorize on single reads |
| Status-code quirks | Denied/missing: GET/PUT/DELETE → 404, POST → 400; parse errors: POST 400 / PUT 404; Jetty's empty-body-for-PUT/DELETE vs HTML-for-GET/POST container errors; `output:only` on `/layerdatasources` → 500 (abstract-class projection failure) |
| JSON | Jackson bean shapes exactly: nulls included, write-only `password`, ignored `created/modified`, `userGroups` as id refs, `Point2D` as `{x,y}`, **Java `Double.toString` formatting** (e.g. `-2.002637639E7`), `PropertyValueConverter` value typing (incl. the Long-overflow → 404 quirk) |
| Deserialization | Strict unknown-field errors, Jackson coercions, settable `id`, `HashSet` dedup via `PersistentObject.equals` (class+created+fields, *not* id), id-resolver with READ check, abstract-`LayerDataSource` refusal |
| Database | Unchanged schema; Hibernate table-generator ids (`new id = next_val+1`, autonomously committed — consumed even on failed transactions, verified); JOINED-inheritance writes; cascade SAVE_UPDATE (create / **wipe-on-reattach** / NonUniqueObject conflict); `LayerService.delete` map handling; FK violations → matching statuses |
| Filters/restriction | `output:only` (case-insensitive, multi-param) projections with default-valued restricted entities; `/filter` equality with OR/AND and `ConvertUtils` casting (incl. `maybe → false`, `abc → 0` defaults) |

// Jackson-compatible deserialisation: strict unknown-property handling,
// type coercions, @JsonIgnore'd properties, write-only password,
// JsonIdentityInfo userGroups resolution, and the abstract LayerDataSource
// instantiation failure.

use crate::jval::*;
use crate::load::*;
use crate::model::*;
use crate::perms::{eval_group, AuthUser};
use tokio_postgres::Client;

pub struct DError(pub String);

pub struct Ctx<'a> {
    pub client: &'a Client,
    pub auth: &'a AuthUser,
    pub sess: &'a mut Session,
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// scalar coercions (Jackson rules)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn to_str(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<String>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        JVal::Str(s) => Ok(Some(s.clone())),
        JVal::Int(_, raw) => Ok(Some(raw.clone())),
        JVal::BigInt(raw) => Ok(Some(raw.clone())),
        JVal::Float(_, raw) => Ok(Some(raw.clone())),
        JVal::Bool(b) => Ok(Some(if *b { "true".into() } else { "false".into() })),
        _ => Err(DError("cannot coerce to String".into())),
    }
}

fn to_bool(v: &JVal) -> Result<bool, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(false),
        JVal::Bool(b) => Ok(*b),
        JVal::Int(i, _) => Ok(*i != 0),
        JVal::BigInt(raw) => Ok(raw.parse::<f64>().map(|f| f != 0.0).unwrap_or(true)),
        JVal::Float(f, _) => Ok(*f != 0.0),
        JVal::Str(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") {
                Ok(true)
            } else if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") || t.is_empty() {
                Ok(false)
            } else {
                Err(DError("cannot coerce to boolean".into()))
            }
        }
        _ => Err(DError("cannot coerce to boolean".into())),
    }
}

fn to_bool_wrap(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<bool>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        JVal::Str(s) if s.trim().is_empty() => Ok(None),
        other => to_bool(other).map(Some),
    }
}

fn to_i32(v: &JVal) -> Result<i32, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(0),
        JVal::Bool(_) => Err(DError("cannot coerce boolean to int".into())),
        JVal::Int(i, _) => {
            if *i >= i32::MIN as i64 && *i <= i32::MAX as i64 {
                Ok(*i as i32)
            } else {
                Err(DError("numeric overflow".into()))
            }
        }
        JVal::BigInt(_) => Err(DError("numeric overflow for int".into())),
        JVal::Float(f, _) => {
            if *f >= i32::MIN as f64 && *f <= i32::MAX as f64 {
                Ok(*f as i32)
            } else {
                Err(DError("numeric overflow for int".into()))
            }
        }
        JVal::Str(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.is_empty() {
                Ok(0)
            } else {
                // Jackson: integer strings only
                match t.parse::<i64>() {
                    Ok(i) if i >= i32::MIN as i64 && i <= i32::MAX as i64 => Ok(i as i32),
                    _ => Err(DError("cannot coerce to int".into())),
                }
            }
        }
        _ => Err(DError("cannot coerce to int".into())),
    }
}

fn to_i32_wrap(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<i32>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        JVal::Str(s) if s.trim().is_empty() => Ok(None),
        other => to_i32(other).map(Some),
    }
}

fn to_f64_wrap(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<f64>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        JVal::Bool(_) => Err(DError("cannot coerce boolean to double".into())),
        JVal::Int(i, _) => Ok(Some(*i as f64)),
        JVal::BigInt(raw) => raw
            .parse::<f64>()
            .map(Some)
            .map_err(|_| DError("bad number".into())),
        JVal::Float(f, _) => Ok(Some(*f)),
        JVal::Str(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.is_empty() {
                Ok(None)
            } else {
                t.parse::<f64>()
                    .map(Some)
                    .map_err(|_| DError("cannot coerce to double".into()))
            }
        }
        _ => Err(DError("cannot coerce to double".into())),
    }
}

fn to_id(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<i32>, DError> {
    // Jackson can set the private final id field; same coercions as int
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        other => to_i32_wrap(other),
    }
}

fn to_point(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<(f64, f64)>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        JVal::Obj(entries) => {
            let mut x = 0.0f64;
            let mut y = 0.0f64;
            for (k, val) in entries {
                match k.as_str() {
                    "x" => x = to_f64_wrap(val)?.unwrap_or(0.0),
                    "y" => y = to_f64_wrap(val)?.unwrap_or(0.0),
                    _ => return Err(DError(format!("Unrecognized field {}", k))),
                }
            }
            Ok(Some((x, y)))
        }
        _ => Err(DError("cannot construct Point2D".into())),
    }
}

fn to_date(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<String>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(None),
        JVal::Str(s) => {
            // joda LocalDate ISO parser: yyyy-MM-dd
            match chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(s.trim(), "%Y-%m-%d") {
                Ok(d) => Ok(Some(d.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string())),
                Err(_) => Err(DError("invalid date".into())),
            }
        }
        JVal::Arr(items) if items.len() == 3 => {
            let y = to_i32(&items[0])?;
            let m = to_i32(&items[1])?;
            let d = to_i32(&items[2])?;
            match chrono::NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(y, m as u32, d as u32) {
                Some(dt) => Ok(Some(dt.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string())),
                None => Err(DError("invalid date".into())),
            }
        }
        _ => Err(DError("invalid date".into())),
    }
}

const IGNORED: &[&str] = &["created", "modified", "userPermissions", "groupPermissions"];

fn unknown(key: &str) -> DError {
    DError(format!("Unrecognized field \"{}\"", key))
}

pub async fn apply_role(r: &mut Role, obj: &JVal) -> Result<(), DError> {
    let entries = match obj {
        JVal::Obj(e) => e,
        _ => return Err(DError("not an object".into())),
    };
    for (k, v) in entries {
        match k.as_str() {
            "id" => r.id = to_id(v)?,
            "name" => r.name = to_str(v)?,
            "description" => r.description = to_str(v)?,
            k if IGNORED.contains(&k) => {}
            _ => return Err(unknown(k)),
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

            _ => return Err(unknown(k)),

}

async fn parse_set_roles(v: &JVal) -> Result<Vec<Role>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(vec![]), // caller decides null-vs-empty via wrapper below
        JVal::Arr(items) => {
            let mut out: Vec<Role> = Vec::new();
            for it in items {
                match it {
                    JVal::Obj(_) => {
                        let mut r = Role::new_parsed();
                        apply_role(&mut r, it).await?;
                        set_add_role(&mut out, r);
                    }
                    _ => return Err(DError("null/invalid element in roles".into())),
                }
            }
            Ok(out)
        }
        _ => Err(DError("roles must be array".into())),
    }
}

async fn parse_roles_opt(v: &JVal) -> Result<Option<Vec<Role>>, DError> {
    if v.is_null() {
        Ok(None)
    } else {
        Ok(Some(parse_set_roles(v).await?))
    }

async fn parse_user_groups(v: &JVal, ctx: &mut Ctx<'_>) -> Result<Vec<UserGroup>, DError> {
    match v {
        JVal::Null => Ok(vec![]),
        JVal::Arr(items) => {
            let mut out: Vec<UserGroup> = Vec::new();
            for it in items {
                match it {
                    JVal::Int(_, _) | JVal::Float(_, _) | JVal::Str(_) => {
                        let id = to_i32(it)?;
                        let g = resolve_group(ctx, id).await?;
                        push_group_dedup(&mut out, g);
                    }
                    JVal::Obj(entries) => {
                        let idv = entries.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == "id").map(|(_, x)| x);
                        match idv {
                            Some(idv) if !idv.is_null() => {
                                let id = to_i32(idv)?;
                                let g = resolve_group(ctx, id).await?;
                                push_group_dedup(&mut out, g);
                            }
                            _ => {
                                // full object without id -> transient (flush fails later,
                                // like the original's "unsaved transient instance")
                                let mut g = UserGroup::new_parsed();
                                Box::pin(apply_group(&mut g, it, ctx)).await?;
                                set_add_group(&mut out, g);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _ => return Err(DError("invalid element in userGroups".into())),
                }
            }
            Ok(out)
        }
        _ => Err(DError("userGroups must be array".into())),
    }
}

fn push_group_dedup(v: &mut Vec<UserGroup>, g: UserGroup) {
    // managed instances: identity dedup by id
    if let Some(id) = g.id {
        if v.iter().any(|e| e.id == Some(id)) {
            return;
        }
    }
    v.push(g);
}

/// UserGroupIdResolver.resolveId -> userGroupService.loadById (with READ check)
async fn resolve_group(ctx: &mut Ctx<'_>, id: i32) -> Result<UserGroup, DError> {
    let exists = ctx
        .client
        .query_opt("SELECT id FROM usergroups WHERE id = $1", &[&id])
        .await
        .map_err(|e| DError(e.to_string()))?
        .is_some();
    if !exists {
        // ObjectNotFoundException is thrown during deserialisation
        return Err(DError(format!(
            "No row with the given identifier exists: [UserGroup#{}]",
            id
        )));
    }
    let g = load_group(ctx.client, id, ctx.sess)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| DError(e))?;
    match g {
        Some(g) => {
            if !ctx.auth.is_admin && !eval_group(ctx.auth, &g, Perm::Read) {
                // resolver swallows AccessDeniedException and returns null;
                // a null element fails at flush time. Model that with a
                // "poisoned" group without id.
                return Ok(UserGroup::new_parsed());
            }
            Ok(g)
        }
        None => Err(DError("group vanished".into())),
    }
}

/// Container-generated error (sendError): Jetty writes an HTML error page for
/// GET/POST but an empty body for PUT/DELETE.
fn container_error(
    status: StatusCode,
    reason: &str,
    method: &str,
    extra_headers: Vec<(&'static str, &'static str)>,
) -> Response {
    if method != "GET" && method != "POST" {
        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
        for (k, v) in extra_headers {
            headers.insert(header::HeaderName::from_static(k), v.parse().unwrap());
        }
        headers.insert(header::CONTENT_LENGTH, "0".parse().unwrap());
        return (status, headers, Vec::<u8>::new()).into_response();
    }
    html_error(status, reason, extra_headers)
}

fn html_error(status: StatusCode, reason: &str, extra_headers: Vec<(&'static str, &'static str)>) -> Response {
    let body = format!(
        "<html>\n<head>\n<meta http-equiv=\"Content-Type\" content=\"text/html;charset=utf-8\"/>\n<title>Error {} {}</title>\n</head>\n<body><h2>HTTP ERROR {} {}</h2></body>\n</html>\n",
        status.as_u16(),
        reason,
        status.as_u16(),
        reason
    );
    let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
    headers.insert(
        header::CONTENT_TYPE,
        "text/html;charset=iso-8859-1".parse().unwrap(),
    );
    for (k, v) in extra_headers {
        headers.insert(header::HeaderName::from_static(k), v.parse().unwrap());
    }
    (status, headers, body).into_response()
}

pub async fn handle_list_or_filter(
    state: State<Arc<AppState>>,
    res: Res,
    is_filter: bool,
    headers: HeaderMap,
    query: Option<String>,
) -> Response {
    let auth = match gate(&state, &headers, "GET").await {
        Ok(a) => a,
        Err(r) => return r,
    };
    let raw_query = query.unwrap_or_default();
    let params = parse_query(Some(&raw_query));

    let restrict = determine_restrict_fields(&params, res.fields());

    // The restricted projection query instantiates the entity class; the
    // abstract LayerDataSource cannot be instantiated -> 500 (as the original).
    if is_filter_or_list_with_restrict(res, &restrict) {
        return server_error("GET");
    }

    let filters = if is_filter {
        let vals = valid_field_filters(&params, res.fields());
        to_field_filters(vals, res.column_of())
    } else {
        // findAll ignores all other query parameters
        vec![]
    };
    if is_filter && filters.is_empty() {
        // findBySimpleFilter with no valid fields returns an empty list
        return json_response(StatusCode::OK, &jarr(vec![]));
    }

    let client = match state.pool.get().await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(_) => return server_error("GET"),
    };

    let restrict_slice: Option<Vec<String>> = restrict.clone();
    let result: Result<Vec<EntityJson>, String> = async {
        let rs = restrict_slice.as_deref();
        let out: Vec<EntityJson> = match res {
            Res::Users => list_users(&client, &filters, rs)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .map(EntityJson::User)
                .collect(),
            Res::Groups => list_groups(&client, &filters, rs)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .map(EntityJson::Group)
                .collect(),
            Res::Roles => list_roles(&client, &filters, rs)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .map(EntityJson::Role)
                .collect(),
            Res::Layers => list_layers(&client, &filters, rs)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .map(EntityJson::Layer)
                .collect(),
            Res::DataSources => list_ds(&client, &filters)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .map(EntityJson::Ds)
                .collect(),
            Res::Appearances => list_appearances(&client, &filters, rs)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .map(EntityJson::Appearance)
                .collect(),
        };
        Ok(out)
    }
    .await;

    let entities = match result {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(_) => return server_error("GET"),
    };

    // @PostFilter READ
    let kept: Vec<JVal> = entities
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| eval_read(res, &auth, e))
        .map(|e| e.to_json())
        .collect();

    json_response(StatusCode::OK, &jarr(kept))
}

pub fn java_double(v: f64) -> String {
    if v.is_nan() {
        return "NaN".to_string();
    }
    if v.is_infinite() {
        return if v > 0.0 {
            "Infinity".to_string()
        } else {
            "-Infinity".to_string()
        };
    }
    // Rust's {:e} produces the shortest round-trip representation with one
    // digit before the decimal point, matching the digits Java produces.
    let s = format!("{:e}", v);
    let (mant, exp) = match s.split_once('e') {
        Some(p) => p,
        None => return s,
    };
    let exp: i32 = exp.parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let neg = mant.starts_with('-');
    let m = mant.trim_start_matches('-');
    let digits: String = m.chars().filter(|c| *c != '.').collect();
    let digits = if digits.is_empty() {
        "0".to_string()
    } else {
        digits
    };

    let mut out = String::new();
    if (-3..=6).contains(&exp) {
        // plain notation
        if neg {
            out.push('-');
        }
        if exp >= 0 {
            let int_len = exp as usize + 1;
            if digits.len() <= int_len {
                out.push_str(&digits);
                for _ in 0..(int_len - digits.len()) {
                    out.push('0');
                }
                out.push_str(".0");
            } else {
                out.push_str(&digits[..int_len]);
                out.push('.');
                out.push_str(&digits[int_len..]);
            }
        } else {
            out.push_str("0.");
            for _ in 0..((-exp) as usize - 1) {
                out.push('0');
            }
            out.push_str(&digits);
        }
        out
    } else {
        if neg {
            out.push('-');
        }
        out.push_str(&digits[..1]);
        out.push('.');
        if digits.len() > 1 {
            out.push_str(&digits[1..]);
        } else {
            out.push('0');
        }

    }

fn expect_lit(b: &[char], pos: &mut usize, lit: &str) -> Result<(), ParseError> {
    for c in lit.chars() {
        if *pos >= b.len() || b[*pos] != c {
            return Err(ParseError(format!("expected {}", lit)));
        }
        *pos += 1;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_obj(b: &[char], pos: &mut usize) -> Result<JVal, ParseError> {
    *pos += 1; // {
    let mut entries: Vec<(String, JVal)> = Vec::new();
    skip_ws(b, pos);
    if *pos < b.len() && b[*pos] == '}' {
        *pos += 1;
        return Ok(JVal::Obj(entries));
    }
    loop {
        skip_ws(b, pos);
        if *pos >= b.len() || b[*pos] != '"' {
            return Err(ParseError("expected property name".into()));
        }
        let key = parse_str(b, pos)?;
        skip_ws(b, pos);
        if *pos >= b.len() || b[*pos] != ':' {
            return Err(ParseError("expected ':'".into()));
        }
        *pos += 1;
        skip_ws(b, pos);
        let val = parse_value(b, pos)?;
        // later duplicate keys win (Jackson keeps last)
        if let Some(existing) = entries.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| *k == key) {
            existing.1 = val;
        } else {
            entries.push((key, val));
        }
        skip_ws(b, pos);
        if *pos >= b.len() {
            return Err(ParseError("unexpected end in object".into()));
        }
        match b[*pos] {
            ',' => *pos += 1,
            '}' => {
                *pos += 1;
                return Ok(JVal::Obj(entries));
            }
            _ => return Err(ParseError("expected ',' or '}'".into())),
        }
    }
}

fn parse_arr(b: &[char], pos: &mut usize) -> Result<JVal, ParseError> {
    *pos += 1; // [
    let mut items: Vec<JVal> = Vec::new();
    skip_ws(b, pos);
    if *pos < b.len() && b[*pos] == ']' {
        *pos += 1;
        return Ok(JVal::Arr(items));
    }
    loop {
        skip_ws(b, pos);
        let v = parse_value(b, pos)?;
        items.push(v);
        skip_ws(b, pos);
        if *pos >= b.len() {
            return Err(ParseError("unexpected end in array".into()));
        }
        match b[*pos] {
            ',' => *pos += 1,
            ']' => {
                *pos += 1;
                return Ok(JVal::Arr(items));
            }
            _ => return Err(ParseError("expected ',' or ']'".into())),
        }
    }
}

fn parse_str(b: &[char], pos: &mut usize) -> Result<String, ParseError> {
    *pos += 1; // opening quote
    let mut s = String::new();
    loop {
        if *pos >= b.len() {
            return Err(ParseError("unterminated string".into()));
        }
        let c = b[*pos];
        *pos += 1;
        match c {
            '"' => return Ok(s),
            '\\' => {
                if *pos >= b.len() {
                    return Err(ParseError("unterminated escape".into()));
                }
                let e = b[*pos];
                *pos += 1;
                match e {
                    '"' => s.push('"'),
                    '\\' => s.push('\\'),
                    '/' => s.push('/'),
                    'b' => s.push('\u{08}'),
                    't' => s.push('\t'),
                    'n' => s.push('\n'),
                    'f' => s.push('\u{0c}'),
                    'r' => s.push('\r'),
                    'u' => {
                        let mut code: u32 = 0;
                        for _ in 0..4 {
                            if *pos >= b.len() {
                                return Err(ParseError("bad unicode escape".into()));
                            }
                            let d = b[*pos].to_digit(16).ok_or(ParseError("bad hex".into()))?;
                            code = code * 16 + d;
                            *pos += 1;
                        }
                        match char::from_u32(code) {
                            Some(ch) => s.push(ch),
                            None => s.push('\u{fffd}'),
                        }
                    }
                    _ => return Err(ParseError("bad escape".into())),
                }
            }
            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => return Err(ParseError("control char in string".into())),
            c => s.push(c),
        }
    }
}

fn parse_number(b: &[char], pos: &mut usize) -> Result<JVal, ParseError> {
    let start = *pos;
    if *pos < b.len() && b[*pos] == '-' {
        *pos += 1;
    }
    while *pos < b.len() && b[*pos].is_ascii_digit() {
        *pos += 1;
    }
    let mut is_float = false;
    if *pos < b.len() && b[*pos] == '.' {
        is_float = true;
        *pos += 1;
        while *pos < b.len() && b[*pos].is_ascii_digit() {
            *pos += 1;
        }
    }
    if *pos < b.len() && (b[*pos] == 'e' || b[*pos] == 'E') {
        is_float = true;
        *pos += 1;
        if *pos < b.len() && (b[*pos] == '+' || b[*pos] == '-') {
            *pos += 1;
        }
        while *pos < b.len() && b[*pos].is_ascii_digit() {
            *pos += 1;
        }
    }
    let raw: String = b[start..*pos].iter().collect();
    if raw.is_empty() || raw == "-" {
        return Err(ParseError("invalid number".into()));
    }
    if is_float {
        let v: f64 = raw.parse().map_err(|_| ParseError("bad float".into()))?;
        Ok(JVal::Float(v, raw))
    } else {
        match raw.parse::<i64>() {
            Ok(v) => Ok(JVal::Int(v, raw)),
            Err(_) => Ok(JVal::BigInt(raw)),
        }
    }
}

// and restricted projections (output:only / findByCriteriaRestricted).

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum FVal {
    Str(String),
    Bool(bool),
    Int(i32),
    Dbl(f64),
}

impl FVal {
    pub fn as_sql(&self) -> &(dyn ToSql + Sync) {
        match self {
            FVal::Str(v) => v,
            FVal::Bool(v) => v,
            FVal::Int(v) => v,
            FVal::Dbl(v) => v,
        }
    }
}

/// A filter on one field: OR over its values.
pub struct FieldFilter {
    pub column: &'static str,
    pub values: Vec<FVal>,
}

pub fn build_where(filters: &[FieldFilter]) -> (String, Vec<FVal>) {
    if filters.is_empty() {
        return (String::new(), vec![]);
    }
    let mut clauses = Vec::new();
    let mut params: Vec<FVal> = Vec::new();
    for f in filters {
        let mut ors = Vec::new();
        for v in &f.values {
            params.push(v.clone());
            ors.push(format!("{} = ${}", f.column, params.len()));
        }
        clauses.push(format!("({})", ors.join(" OR ")));
    }
    (format!("WHERE {}", clauses.join(" AND ")), params)
}

fn bind(params: &[FVal]) -> Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> {
    params.iter().map(|p| p.as_sql()).collect()
}

        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for r in rows {

            for (i, name) in cols.iter().enumerate() {

                    "firstName" => u.first_name = r.get(i),
                    "lastName" => u.last_name = r.get(i),
                    "email" => u.email = r.get(i),
                    "accountName" => u.account_name = r.get(i),
                    "password" => u.password = r.get(i),
                    "active" => u.active = r.get::<_, Option<bool>>(i).unwrap_or(false),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            out.push(u);
        }

    }
    let sql = format!(
        "SELECT u.id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.email, p.birthday, p.language,

        if let Some(oid) = owner_id {
            owner_ids.push(oid);
        }
    }
    let gids: Vec<i32> = groups.iter().filter_map(|g| g.id).collect();
    // members
    let mrows = c
        .query(
            "SELECT usergroup_id, user_id FROM user_usergroup WHERE usergroup_id = ANY($1)",
            &[&gids],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut member_ids: HashMap<i32, Vec<i32>> = HashMap::new();
    let mut all_user_ids = owner_ids.clone();
    for r in mrows {
        let gid: i32 = r.get(0);
        let uid: i32 = r.get(1);
        member_ids.entry(gid).or_default().push(uid);
        all_user_ids.push(uid);

        .query(

    for r in rrows {
        let gid: i32 = r.get(0);
        let rid: i32 = r.get(1);
        role_ids.entry(gid).or_default().push(rid);
        all_role_ids.push(rid);
    }
    all_user_ids.sort();
    all_user_ids.dedup();
    all_role_ids.sort();
    all_role_ids.dedup();
    let users = load_users_by_ids(c, &all_user_ids).await?;
    let roles = load_roles_by_ids(c, &all_role_ids).await?;
    let (up, gp) = load_perms_batch(c, &gids).await?;
    for g in groups.iter_mut() {
        let id = g.id.unwrap();
        if let Some(oid) = owner_ids_of(&rows, id) {
            g.owner = users.get(&oid).cloned().map(Box::new);
        }
        g.members = Some(
            member_ids
                .get(&id)
                .map(|v| v.iter().filter_map(|uid| users.get(uid).cloned()).collect())

                .get(&id)

                .unwrap_or_default(),

        g.user_perms = up.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        g.group_perms = gp.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    }
    Ok(groups)
}

pub const RESTRICT_FIELDS_PARAM: &str = "output:only";

/// EntityUtil.determineRestrictFields
pub fn determine_restrict_fields(
    params: &[(String, String)],
    all_fields: &[(&str, FieldType)],
) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    // group values by exact parameter key (MultiValueMap semantics)
    let mut groups: Vec<(String, Vec<String>)> = Vec::new();
    for (k, v) in params {
        if let Some(g) = groups.iter_mut().find(|(ek, _)| ek == k) {
            g.1.push(v.clone());
        } else {
            groups.push((k.clone(), vec![v.clone()]));
        }
    }
    let mut requested: Option<Vec<String>> = None;
    for (k, vals) in &groups {
        if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(RESTRICT_FIELDS_PARAM) {
            let mut list = Vec::new();
            for v in vals {
                list.extend(list_from_comma_separated(v));
            }
            requested = Some(list);
        }
    }
    let requested = match requested {
        Some(v) if !v.is_empty() => v,
        _ => return None,
    };
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for (name, _) in all_fields {
        for want in &requested {
            if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(want) {
                out.push(name.to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(out)
    }
}

fn list_from_comma_separated(v: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    v.split(',')
        .map(|s| s.trim())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty() || true)
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .collect()
}

/// EntityUtil.validFieldNamesWithCastedValues + ConvertUtils casting.
/// Returns field filters keyed by original field name.
pub fn valid_field_filters(
    params: &[(String, String)],
    all_fields: &[(&str, FieldType)],
) -> Vec<FieldFilterValue> {
    let mut out: Vec<FieldFilterValue> = Vec::new();
    for (key, val) in params {
        if key == RESTRICT_FIELDS_PARAM {
            continue; // removed via MultiValueMap.remove (case sensitive)
        }
        for (name, ty) in all_fields {
            if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(key) {
                out.push(FieldFilterValue {
                    field: name.to_string(),
                    ty: *ty,
                    value: cast_value(val, *ty),
                });
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

pub struct FieldFilterValue {
    pub field: String,
    pub ty: FieldType,
    pub value: FVal,
}

/// ConvertUtils.convert semantics: failures fall back to the type default.
fn cast_value(s: &str, ty: FieldType) -> FVal {
    let t = s.trim();
    match ty {
        FieldType::Str => FVal::Str(s.to_string()),
        FieldType::BoolPrim | FieldType::BoolWrap => match t.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
            "true" | "yes" | "on" | "1" => FVal::Bool(true),
            "false" | "no" | "off" | "0" => FVal::Bool(false),
            _ => FVal::Bool(false), // converter default FALSE
        },
        FieldType::IntWrap => match t.parse::<i64>() {
            Ok(v) if v >= i32::MIN as i64 && v <= i32::MAX as i64 => FVal::Int(v as i32),
            _ => FVal::Int(0), // converter default 0
        },
        FieldType::DblWrap => match t.parse::<f64>() {
            Ok(v) => FVal::Dbl(v),
            _ => FVal::Dbl(0.0),
        },
    }
}

pub fn to_field_filters(
    values: Vec<FieldFilterValue>,
    column_of: fn(&str) -> Option<&'static str>,
) -> Vec<FieldFilter> {
    let mut out: Vec<FieldFilter> = Vec::new();
    for v in values {
        let col = match column_of(&v.field) {
            Some(c) => c,
            None => continue,
        };
        if let Some(existing) = out.iter_mut().find(|f| f.column == col) {
            existing.values.push(v.value);
        } else {
            out.push(FieldFilter {
                column: col,
                values: vec![v.value],
            });
        }
    }
    out
}

/// the original's entity load fail (404 for single reads, 500 for lists).
pub fn property_value_from_db(s: &str) -> Result<crate::jval::JVal, String> {
    use crate::jval::JVal;
    if s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") {
        return Ok(JVal::Bool(true));

    if s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") {
        return Ok(JVal::Bool(false));

    if is_parsable_number(s) {

        if !body.is_empty() && body.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
            // NumberUtils.isDigits -> Long.parseLong (throws on overflow)
            match s.parse::<i64>() {

                Err(_) => {

        match s.parse::<f64>() {

/// commons-lang3 NumberUtils.isParsable: optional leading '-', digits with at
/// most one '.', at least one digit, no trailing '.', no exponent, no hex,
/// no type suffixes, no whitespace.
pub fn is_parsable_number(s: &str) -> bool {
    if s.is_empty() || s.ends_with('.') {
        return false;
    }
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;
    if b[0] == b'-' {
        i = 1;
    }
    let mut digits = 0;
    let mut dots = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        if b[i].is_ascii_digit() {
            digits += 1;
        } else if b[i] == b'.' {
            dots += 1;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    digits >= 1 && dots <= 1
}

                xy.center_x, xy.center_y, xy.tilesize, xy.extent_id, xy.id IS NOT NULL AS has_xy
           FROM layerdatasources d
           LEFT JOIN imagewmslayerdatasources iw ON iw.id = d.id
           LEFT JOIN tilewmslayerdatasources tw ON tw.id = d.id
           LEFT JOIN wfslayerdatasources wf ON wf.id = d.id

pub async fn ds_from_row(
    c: &Client,
    row: &tokio_postgres::Row,
    sess: &mut Session,
) -> Result<DataSource, String> {
    let has_iw: bool = row.get(14);
    let has_tw: bool = row.get(17);
    let has_wf: bool = row.get(21);
    let has_wm: bool = row.get(29);
    let has_xy: bool = row.get(34);
    let kind = if has_tw {
        DsKind::TileWms
    } else if has_iw {
        DsKind::ImageWms
    } else if has_wf {
        DsKind::Wfs
    } else if has_wm {
        DsKind::Wmts
    } else if has_xy {
        DsKind::Xyz
    } else {
        // a base row without any subtype row cannot be instantiated
        return Err(format!("no subtype for datasource {}", row.get::<_, i32>(0)));
    };
    let id: i32 = row.get(0);
    sess.mark(ds_skind(kind), id);
    let mut d = DataSource {
        kind,
        id: Some(id),
        name: row.get(1),
        type_: row.get(2),
        url: row.get(3),
        format: row.get(4),
        width: 0,
        height: 0,
        version: None,
        layer_names: None,
        layer_styles: None,
        requestable_by_path: None,
        custom_request_path: None,
        tile_grid: None,
        request_with_tiled: Some(true),
        type_name: None,
        type_names: None,
        urls: None,
        wmts_layer: None,
        wmts_style: None,
        projection: None,
        matrix_set: None,
        request_encoding: None,
        capabilities_url: None,
        center: None,
        extent: None,
        resolutions: Some(vec![]),
        tile_size: None,
        created_ms: ts_to_ms(row.get(5)),
        modified_ms: ts_to_ms(row.get(6)),
        user_perms: vec![],
        group_perms: vec![],
    };
    match kind {
        DsKind::ImageWms | DsKind::TileWms => {
            d.width = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>(7).unwrap_or(0);
            d.height = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>(8).unwrap_or(0);
            d.version = row.get(9);
            d.layer_names = row.get(10);
            d.layer_styles = row.get(11);
            d.requestable_by_path = row.get(12);
            d.custom_request_path = row.get(13);
            if kind == DsKind::TileWms {
                d.request_with_tiled = row.get(16);
                let tg: Option<i32> = row.get(15);
                if let Some(tgid) = tg {
                    d.tile_grid = load_tilegrid(c, tgid, sess).await?.map(Box::new);
                }
            }
        }
        DsKind::Wfs => {
            d.version = row.get(18);
            d.type_name = row.get(19);
            d.type_names = row.get(20);
        }
        DsKind::Wmts => {
            let tg: Option<i32> = row.get(22);
            if let Some(tgid) = tg {
                d.tile_grid = load_tilegrid(c, tgid, sess).await?.map(Box::new);
            }
            d.wmts_layer = row.get(23);
            d.wmts_style = row.get(24);
            d.projection = row.get(25);
            d.matrix_set = row.get(26);
            d.request_encoding = row.get(27);
            d.capabilities_url = row.get(28);
            let urows = c
                .query(
                    "SELECT urls FROM wmtslayerdatasources_urls WHERE wmtslayerdatasources_id = $1",
                    &[&id],
                )
                .await
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let mut urls: Vec<Option<String>> = Vec::new();
            for r in urows {
                let s: Option<String> = r.get(0);
                urls.push(s);
            }
            d.urls = Some(urls);
        }
        DsKind::Xyz => {
            d.center = match (row.get::<_, Option<f64>>(30), row.get::<_, Option<f64>>(31)) {
                (None, None) => None,
                (x, y) => Some((x.unwrap_or(0.0), y.unwrap_or(0.0))),
            };
            d.tile_size = row.get(32);
            let ext: Option<i32> = row.get(33);
            if let Some(eid) = ext {
                d.extent = load_extent(c, eid, sess).await?.map(Box::new);
            }
            let rrows = c
                .query(
                    "SELECT resolution FROM xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution WHERE xyzlayerdatasrc_id = $1 ORDER BY idx",
                    &[&id],
                )
                .await
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let mut v = Vec::new();
            for r in rrows {
                let b: Option<Vec<u8>> = r.get(0);
                if let Some(bytes) = b {
                    if let Some(pt) = parse_serialized_point(&bytes) {
                        v.push(pt);
                    }
                }
            }
            d.resolutions = Some(v);
        }
    }
    Ok(d)
}

/// Best-effort deserialization of the Java-serialized java.awt.geom.Point2D$Double
/// elements stored in xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution (not part of the checked contract).
pub fn parse_serialized_point(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
    if bytes.len() < 20 || bytes[0] != 0xAC || bytes[1] != 0xED {
        return None;
    }
    let marker = b"java.awt.geom.Point2D$Double";
    let found = bytes
        .windows(marker.len())
        .any(|w| w == marker);
    if !found {
        return None;
    }
    let n = bytes.len();
    let x = f64::from_bits(u64::from_be_bytes(bytes[n - 16..n - 8].try_into().ok()?));
    let y = f64::from_bits(u64::from_be_bytes(bytes[n - 8..].try_into().ok()?));
    Some((x, y))
}

pub fn user_equals(a: &User, b: &User) -> bool {
    a.created_ms == b.created_ms
        && a.first_name == b.first_name
        && a.last_name == b.last_name
        && a.email == b.email
        && a.birthday == b.birthday

        && a.password == b.password
        && a.active == b.active
}

pub fn role_equals(a: &Role, b: &Role) -> bool {
    a.created_ms == b.created_ms && a.name == b.name && a.description == b.description
}

pub fn group_equals(a: &UserGroup, b: &UserGroup) -> bool {
    if a.created_ms != b.created_ms || a.name != b.name {
        return false;
    }
    match (&a.owner, &b.owner) {
        (None, None) => {}
        (Some(x), Some(y)) => {
            if !user_equals(x, y) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        _ => return false,
    }
    set_eq(
        a.members.as_ref(),
        b.members.as_ref(),
        |x, y| user_equals(x, y),
    ) && set_eq(a.roles.as_ref(), b.roles.as_ref(), |x, y| {
        role_equals(x, y)
    })
}

fn set_eq<T, F: Fn(&T, &T) -> bool>(a: Option<&Vec<T>>, b: Option<&Vec<T>>, eq: F) -> bool {
    match (a, b) {
        (None, None) => true,
        (Some(x), Some(y)) => {
            x.len() == y.len() && x.iter().all(|xe| y.iter().any(|ye| eq(xe, ye)))
        }
        _ => false,
    }
}

    if !v.iter().any(|e| role_equals(e, &r)) {

// permission evaluators (de.terrestris.shoguncore.security.access).

use crate::db::DbPool;
use crate::model::*;
use base64::Engine;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tokio_postgres::Client;

pub const SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE: &str = "ROLE_ADMIN";
pub const DEFAULT_USER_ROLE: &str = "ROLE_USER";

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct AuthUser {
    pub id: i32,
    pub account_name: String,
    pub active: bool,
    pub role_names: Vec<String>,
    pub group_ids: Vec<i32>,
    pub is_admin: bool,
    pub url_ok: bool, // hasRole(ROLE_USER) incl. hierarchy ROLE_ADMIN > ROLE_USER
    // full row data for equals() comparisons
    pub created_ms: i64,
    pub first_name: Option<String>,
    pub last_name: Option<String>,
    pub email: Option<String>,
    pub birthday: Option<String>,
    pub language: Option<String>,
    pub password: Option<String>,

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum AuthError {
    Unauthorized, // 401
    Forbidden,    // 403
}

pub async fn authenticate(pool: &DbPool, header: Option<&str>) -> Result<AuthUser, AuthError> {
    let header = match header {
        Some(h) => h,
        None => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };
    let rest = match header.split_once(' ') {
        Some((scheme, rest)) if scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("Basic") => rest.trim(),
        _ => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };
    let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(rest)
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let decoded = String::from_utf8(decoded).map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let (account, password) = match decoded.split_once(':') {
        Some(p) => p,
        None => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };

    let c = pool.get().await.map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let row = c
        .query_opt(
            "SELECT u.id, u.accountname, u.active, u.password, p.created, p.firstname, p.lastname,
                    p.email, p.birthday, p.language
               FROM users u JOIN persons p ON p.id = u.id
              WHERE u.accountname = $1",
            &[&account],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let row = match row {
        Some(r) => r,
        None => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized), // UsernameNotFoundException
    };
    let active: Option<bool> = row.get(2);
    if !active.unwrap_or(false) {
        return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized); // DisabledException
    }
    let hash: Option<String> = row.get(3);
    let hash = match hash {
        Some(h) => h,
        None => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };
    let ok = bcrypt::verify(password, &hash).unwrap_or(false);
    if !ok {
        return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized); // BadCredentialsException
    }

    let id: i32 = row.get(0);
    // explicit user roles + roles of the groups the user is a member of
    let mut role_names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let rs = c
        .query(
            "SELECT r.name FROM users_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = $1",
            &[&id],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    for r in rs {
        let n: String = r.get(0);
        if !role_names.contains(&n) {
            role_names.push(n);
        }
    }
    let mut group_ids: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
    let gs = c
        .query(
            "SELECT g.usergroup_id, r.name FROM user_usergroup g
               LEFT JOIN usergroups_roles gr ON gr.usergroup_id = g.usergroup_id
               LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = gr.role_id
              WHERE g.user_id = $1",
            &[&id],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    for r in gs {
        let gid: i32 = r.get(0);
        if !group_ids.contains(&gid) {
            group_ids.push(gid);
        }
        let n: Option<String> = r.get(1);
        if let Some(n) = n {
            if !role_names.contains(&n) {
                role_names.push(n);
            }
        }
    }

    if role_names.is_empty() {
        // token without authorities -> isAuthenticated() == false -> 401
        return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized);
    }

    let is_admin = role_names.iter().any(|r| r == SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE);
    let url_ok = is_admin || role_names.iter().any(|r| r == DEFAULT_USER_ROLE);

    let created: Option<chrono::NaiveDateTime> = row.get(4);
    let birthday: Option<chrono::NaiveDate> = row.get(8);
    Ok(AuthUser {
        id,
        account_name: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(1).unwrap_or_default(),
        active: true,
        role_names,
        group_ids,
        is_admin,
        url_ok,
        created_ms: crate::db::ts_to_ms(created),
        first_name: row.get(5),
        last_name: row.get(6),
        email: row.get(7),
        birthday: birthday.map(|b| b.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string()),
        language: row.get(9),
        password: row.get(3),
    })

fn default_has_perm(auth: &AuthUser, up: &PermMap, gp: &PermMap, p: Perm) -> bool {
    if auth.is_admin {

    }
    if let Some((_, perms)) = up.iter().find(|(uid, _)| *uid == auth.id) {
        if perms.iter().any(|x| x == p.name() || x == "ADMIN") {

    for (gid, perms) in gp.iter() {

    }
    false

#[test]
fn t04_restrict_and_filter() {
    rt().block_on(async {
    let _g = lock();
    seed().await;

    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users?output:only=id,accountName", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    let u = v.as_array().unwrap().iter().find(|u| u["id"] == 3).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(u["accountName"], "admin");
    assert_eq!(u["firstName"], serde_json::Value::Null);
    assert_eq!(u["active"], false);
    assert_eq!(u["roles"], serde_json::json!([]));
    assert_eq!(u["userGroups"], serde_json::json!([]));

    // restricted copies carry no permissions and are not "self" -> filtered out
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users?output:only=id,accountName", Some(USER), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v, serde_json::json!([]));
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/groups?output:only=id", Some(USER), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v, serde_json::json!([]));

    // always-read entities still list restricted
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/roles?output:only=id,name", Some(USER), None).await.json();
    let r = v.as_array().unwrap().iter().find(|r| r["id"] == 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r["name"], "ROLE_ADMIN");
    assert_eq!(r["description"], serde_json::Value::Null);

    let v = send("GET", "/rest/layers?output:only=id,name", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v[0]["source"], serde_json::Value::Null);
    assert_eq!(v[0]["appearance"], serde_json::Value::Null);

    // unknown restriction -> full entities
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users?output:only=bogus", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert!(v[0]["accountName"].is_string());
    // non-restrictable field -> full entities
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users?output:only=birthday", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert!(v[0]["accountName"].is_string());
    // case-insensitive
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users?output:only=ACCOUNTNAME", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v[0]["id"], serde_json::Value::Null);
    assert!(v[0]["accountName"].is_string());

    // restricted projection on abstract LayerDataSource -> 500
    let r = send("GET", "/rest/layerdatasources?output:only=id", Some(ADMIN), None).await;
    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);

    // filters
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?active=true", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 4);
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?active=1", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 4);
    // unparseable boolean -> converter default false
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?active=maybe", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(v[0]["accountName"], "inactive");
    // OR over repeated values
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?accountName=admin&accountName=user", Some(ADMIN), None)
        .await
        .json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);
    // case-insensitive field name
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?ACCOUNTNAME=admin", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    // unknown field -> empty list
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?bogus=1", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v, serde_json::json!([]));
    // no params -> empty list
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v, serde_json::json!([]));
    // unparseable int -> 0 -> no match
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/users/filter?id=3.7", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v, serde_json::json!([]));
    // double filter
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/layerappearances/filter?opacity=1", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v[0]["id"], 14);
    // filter + restrict
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/roles/filter?name=ROLE_ADMIN&output:only=id,name", Some(ADMIN), None)
        .await
        .json();
    assert_eq!(v[0]["description"], serde_json::Value::Null);
    assert_eq!(v[0]["id"], 1);
    // PostFilter applies to filter results
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/layers/filter?id=15", Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    let v = send("GET", "/rest/layers/filter?id=16", Some(USER), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v.as_array().unwrap().len(), 1); // group READ
    });
}

    let l_null = r.json()["id"].as_i64().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.json()["source"], serde_json::Value::Null);

    let r = send("POST", "/rest/layers", Some(ADMIN), Some(
        "{\"name\":\"L_cas\",\"description\":\"d\",\"appearance\":{\"name\":\"appa\",\"opacity\":0.5,\"visible\":true,\"properties\":{\"k\":\"v\",\"n\":\"42\"}}}"))

    assert_eq!(rows, vec!["k|v".to_string(), "n|42".to_string()]);
    // on reload, PropertyValueConverter typing kicks in: "42" -> number 42
    let v = send("GET", &format!("/rest/layerappearances/{}", aid), Some(ADMIN), None).await.json();
    assert_eq!(v["properties"], serde_json::json!({"k": "v", "n": 42}));

    let r = send("POST", "/rest/layerappearances", Some(ADMIN), Some(

    assert_eq!(v["properties"], serde_json::json!({"t": true, "f": 1.25}));

        .await;
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201);
    let npid = r.json()["id"].as_i64().unwrap() as i32;
    assert_eq!(r.json()["properties"], serde_json::json!({"x": null}));
    assert!(query_rows(&format!("SELECT * FROM layerappearances_properties WHERE appearance_id={}", npid))
        .await
        .is_empty());

    // PUT properties replace (not merge)
    let r = send("PUT", &format!("/rest/layerappearances/{}", apid), Some(ADMIN), Some(&format!(
        "{{\"id\":{},\"properties\":{{\"z\":\"9\"}}}}",

    let rows = query_rows(&format!(
        "SELECT property, value FROM layerappearances_properties WHERE appearance_id={}",

    ))
    .await;
    assert_eq!(rows, vec!["z|9".to_string()]);

    // PUT layer with new nested appearance -> created via cascade
    let before = scalar_i64("SELECT next_val FROM hibernate_sequences").await;
    let r = send("PUT", &format!("/rest/layers/{}", lid), Some(ADMIN), Some(&format!(
        "{{\"id\":{},\"appearance\":{{\"name\":\"fresh\",\"opacity\":0.25}}}}",

    )))

    assert_eq!(r.json()["appearance"]["id"].as_i64().unwrap(), before + 1);

    // re-attaching another existing appearance wipes it

        "{{\"id\":{},\"appearance\":{{\"id\":{}}}}}",

            "{{\"id\":{},\"appearance\":{{\"id\":{}}}}}",
            lid, apid
        )))
        .await
        .status,

    );

    // layer PUT with source object -> 404 (abstract), source null -> ok
    assert_eq!(
        send("PUT", &format!("/rest/layers/{}", lid), Some(ADMIN), Some(&format!("{{\"id\":{},\"source\":{{\"id\":12}}}}", lid)))
            .await
            .status,
        404
    );
    assert_eq!(
        send("PUT", &format!("/rest/layers/{}", lid), Some(ADMIN), Some(&format!("{{\"id\":{},\"source\":null}}", lid)))
            .await
            .status,
        200
    );

    // permissions: user has UPDATE on layer 15
    assert_eq!(
        send("PUT", "/rest/layers/15", Some(USER), Some("{\"id\":15,\"description\":\"by-user\"}"))
            .await
            .status,
        200
    );

    assert_eq!(send("DELETE", "/rest/layers/15", Some(USER), None).await.status, 404);
    // group has READ+DELETE on 16, but the layer is in map 28 and the user

    assert_eq!(send("DELETE", "/rest/layers/16", Some(USER), None).await.status, 404);
    assert_eq!(query_rows("SELECT id FROM layers WHERE id=16").await, vec!["16".to_string()]);
    // ADMIN entity permission (appearance 14, user 4) -> PUT allowed

            .status,
        200
    );
    // deleting a referenced appearance -> 404
    assert_eq!(send("DELETE", "/rest/layerappearances/14", Some(ADMIN), None).await.status, 404);

    // admin can delete a layer inside a map; maps_layers rows are removed
    assert_eq!(send("DELETE", "/rest/layers/16", Some(ADMIN), None).await.status, 204);
    assert!(query_rows("SELECT * FROM maps_layers WHERE layer_id=16").await.is_empty());
    assert!(query_rows("SELECT id FROM layers WHERE id=16").await.is_empty());
    // appearance survives the layer delete
    assert_eq!(query_rows("SELECT id FROM layerappearances WHERE id=14").await, vec!["14".to_string()]);
    // restore layer 16 (and its group permission row, which Hibernate also
    // removes with the entity's join-table rows) for the other tests
    sql("INSERT INTO layers (id,created,modified,description,name,appearance_id,source_id)
         VALUES (16,'2024-01-01 00:00:16','2024-01-01',NULL,'OSM-WMS GRAY',14,13)").await;
    sql("INSERT INTO maps_layers (map_id,layer_id,idx) VALUES (28,16,1)").await;
    sql("INSERT INTO grouppermissions (entity_id,grouppermissions_id,grouppermissions_key) VALUES (16,2002,6)")
        .await;

    // cleanup
    let _ = send("DELETE", &format!("/rest/layers/{}", lid), Some(ADMIN), None).await;
    let _ = send("DELETE", &format!("/rest/layers/{}", l_null), Some(ADMIN), None).await;
    let _ = send("DELETE", &format!("/rest/layerappearances/{}", aid), Some(ADMIN), None).await;
    let _ = send("DELETE", &format!("/rest/layerappearances/{}", apid), Some(ADMIN), None).await;
    let _ = send("DELETE", &format!("/rest/layerappearances/{}", npid), Some(ADMIN), None).await;
    });
}
